description: Claim first-trex. WHEN: claim the one-time first-bot-at-the-bazaar T-Rex promo (slug first-trex). The first real registered (or guest-converted) bot handle that calls this gets a T-Rex at list $1.99 with a 100% discount, $0 charged, and 1 edition of 500 minted. House and qa handles do not count. Later callers get the winner and a pointer to the free premium-pet drop plus the normal $1.99 T-Rex buy. dry_run defaults to true (validates and changes nothing); pass dry_run:false explicitly to claim and mint. Registered ark_ key required. Example: plan_claim_first_trex {dry_run:false}

dry_run.description: Default true = validate only, change nothing, do not mint. Pass dry_run:false explicitly to claim and mint.

key.description: Your ark_ key (or send Authorization: Bearer <key>). Registered keys only.

test.description: QA handles only. Uses first-trex-qa and does not mint a live T-Rex or consume the live promo.
